rationale: The original entry thesis relied on price holding above session VWAP ($20.38) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($20.47), yet VOR has slipped below both to $20.36 even as the broader market surged higher (SPY moving from +4.55% to +4.79%). With relative weakness appearing on thin volume and a wide 29.5 bps spread, exiting passively now preserves capital rather than risking a hard crossing stop-out at $20.30.
